# Stress scenario (`stress-scenario` v1)

A named historical or hypothetical shock set.

**Group:** Market risk · **Mnemonic:** `SCN` · **Identifiers:** `SCN-…` in `scenarioId`

Open one with `SCN <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: stress-scenario
version: 1
description: A named historical or hypothetical shock set.
match: { kind: stress-scenario, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market risk · Stress scenario, id: $.scenarioId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Type, bind: $.type }
  - { label: Severity, bind: $.severity, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: shocks
    kind: table
    title: Shocks
    key: F2
    rows: $.shocks
    columns:
      - { label: Risk factor, bind: "@.factor" }
      - { label: Shock, bind: "@.shock" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
